correctness.rationale: Reassessed /workspace/repairs/5/RESULT.md. The frozen Proof incorrectly said the trace points opposite to the declared first-to-second map. For the printed pair (M,K), trace does go first to second; the type error is that the second component K cannot carry the required compatible M-action. The repair corrects this false claim and disambiguates the printed root label. The orbit sums give (1,0),(0,1),(3,1),(3,2),(1,1),(2,1) after splitting the cubic leaf field. The first two entries are simple and each valid injective map to a one-dimensional M-target is indecomposable, leaving orbit 4 missing in print. The repaired matrices and intertwining coefficients were checked by python3 /workspace/branches/independent-checks/check_triality.py: rank nine of the 9-by-12 system gives endomorphism dimension three; the exhibited endomorphism has the stated cubic, with no root mod 7, so its field already exhausts the algebra. The explicit representative is only for Q(cube root of 2); general existence uses Theorem 2.3.
